purpose: Teach: 賠償/失業/暴力団/ヒトラー/文部省/王朝/満州/殺す

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療事故の、本気で、絶対、賠償、絶対、制度、絶対、医療界、絶対、改革中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, the medical incident compensation system is being reformed seriously. I'm genuinely grateful for your interest.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Slight pause after his name. Steady eye contact. The voice of someone speaking about difficult institutional work with quiet resolve.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療従事者の、本気で、絶対、失業、絶対、防止、絶対、医療界、絶対、進めていらっしゃるんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So you're actively working to prevent medical workers from losing their jobs and advancing the field. I really appreciate that, sensei.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine. Slight wonder beneath the respectful tone. Not flattering — truly considering what she does. Careful articulation, as if the words matter.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの中に、本気で、絶対、暴力団、絶対、関係者、絶対、いらっしゃると、絶対、警戒、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Among our patients, there are some with organized crime connections, so we have to remain alert.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not harsh. A practical warning stated without drama. Eyes steady. The tone of someone who has learned to name difficult realities plainly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 戦時の、本気で、絶対、ヒトラー、絶対、政権下の医療史、絶対、研究、絶対、続けていらっしゃるそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard you continue to research medical history during wartime, particularly under the Hitler regime. That's remarkable work, sensei.
lines.style: Genuinely curious, respectful. Slight hesitation before naming the historical period — not discomfort, but the care of approaching serious history. Leaning forward slightly in attention.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医学教育の、本気で、絶対、文部省、絶対、ガイドライン、絶対、参考に、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We reference the Ministry of Education guidelines when developing our medical curriculum.
lines.style: Informative, professional. Direct statement of institutional practice. Measured pace. No elaboration — just the fact, cleanly stated. Steady presence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 古代の、本気で、絶対、王朝、絶対、医療制度、絶対、医療史で、絶対、興味深いですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ancient dynasty medical systems are really fascinating from a historical perspective, aren't they? I'd love to hear more about that.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity with a note of warmth. Animated but not overeager. The enthusiasm of someone who finds history genuinely interesting, not performing interest.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。戦時の、本気で、絶対、満州、絶対、医療隊、絶対、記録、絶対、医療界、絶対、保管しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We maintain records of medical units from wartime Manchuria in our institutional archives for historical preservation.
lines.style: Patient, archival tone. Speaking as a custodian of difficult history. No evasion, no over-explanation. Just the weight of what is kept and why.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療では、本気で、絶対、人を、絶対、殺す、絶対、ことなく、絶対、命を、絶対、救う、絶対、ことが、絶対、使命ですよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Medicine's real mission is to save lives without taking them. That's what we're bound to, isn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The statement lands gently but with bedrock certainty. Slow, deliberate pace. Eyes steady on hers. This is what he believes.
